name: console-05-supply
prompt: Turn this into another tab of the same client screen in the console, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep exactly: the left sidebar, the client header (the orange rounded tile with a white m, "Munchly Foods", "munchly.smartclearance.com", the green "Live" pill) and the tab row, but now the "Supply chain" tab is selected instead of "Agents". Replace everything under the tabs: no agent list and no Negotiator panel remain. Under the tabs: 1) A wide white card across the top showing the chain as a left-to-right diagram with small green icons and arrows: "Munchly Foods · plant, Pune" → "4 distributors · own the stock they buy" → two stacked end points "195 kiranas · on the salesmen's beats" and "Quick-commerce warehouses · Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart". 2) Bottom left, a white card "Profile" with six rows, each a bold label and a grey value on the right with a small "Edit" link: "Route to market · through 4 distributors", "Who owns short-dated stock · the distributor, bought at ₹22.00", "Expiry policy · full credit at expiry, so Munchly pays price support first", "Quick-commerce gates · Blinkit 90+ days; Zepto and Instamart 60% of life", "Territory guard · lots hidden inside Munchly's territories", "Return window · 20 days". 3) Bottom right, a white card "Distributors" with a table: columns "Distributor", "City", "Kiranas", "Staff sale cap", "Permission"; rows "Rakesh Traders · Nagpur · 38 · 50 · given" (green pill), "Patil Distributors · Pune · 52 · none · not yet" (amber pill), "Gupta & Sons · Indore · 47 · none · not yet" (amber pill), "Lakshmi Agencies · Hyderabad · 58 · 150 · given" (green pill); a small link "Invite a distributor". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Munchly Foods, Supply chain tab: a chain diagram from the Pune plant to 4 distributors to 195 kiranas and quick-commerce warehouses; a profile card with six editable rows; a distributors table with permission given for Rakesh Traders and Lakshmi Agencies and not yet for Patil Distributors and Gupta & Sons.
